title: Implement t-SNE Gradient Calculation
prompt: Compute the t-SNE gradient for a symmetric zero-diagonal probability matrix P summing to one and low-dimensional coordinates Y. Use Student-t affinities and return 4*sum_j((P-Q)*affinity*(y_i-y_j)).
